content:
Microsoft Defender support process is designed to help you find solutions to common
problems and submit support cases to the Microsoft support team.
You must meet the following requirements before you can open a support case:
You must have either the Service Support Administrator or Helpdesk Administrator role.
For more information on role permissions, see Security Administrator permissions.
For more information on admin roles, see About admin roles.
You must have a Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Plan 1 or Plan 2 license. If your
organization uses only Defender for Servers Plan 1 or Plan 2, you'll also need at least one
Defender for Endpoint license to open a support case.
1. Select the question mark on the top right of the Defender portal page
2. Type your question into the How can we help? search box.
